description:

Implement:
- Detect language from fence info string (```elixir, ```python, etc.)
- Apply syntax coloring via NimbleOptions/Makeup or similar Elixir lib
- Theme-based color scheme

Upstream: theme.ts highlightCode, markdown.ts code block rendering
Depends on: markdown renderer, theme
title: Syntax highlighting in fenced code blocks
